title: Some shayari?
excerpt: Welcome. I have a hobby of reading and writing shayaris, some of these might be originals while others the best of some I liked.
body:
- silsila hi na hota, koi gila hi na hota, ya toh mil gaya hota ya mila hi na hota

- meri dosti ka bageecha chota hai magar phool saare gulab rakhta hoon, dost beshak kam kyu na ho, jitne rakhta hoon lajawab rakhta hoon
